codex_deep_telemetry.source: Local Codex rollout JSONL token_count / turn_context / response_item records
codex_deep_telemetry.semantics: Codex input_tokens includes cached input. New input is computed as input_tokens - cached_input_tokens. Processed totals sum context/token accounting across model turns and are not unique-token or billing totals.

antigravity_deep_telemetry.semantics: Antigravity records input_tokens and cache_read_tokens separately. Prompt context is input + cache-read. It stores thinking text but no authoritative hidden thinking-token count, so the dashboard reports thinking steps/characters/words rather than fabricating thinking tokens. Remaining quota percentage is not exposed by the local CLI.
antigravity_deep_telemetry.model_attribution: Historical model grouping uses the model explicitly named in the recorded MJobs lane launch prompt; it is not provider billing attribution.
